subject: english
question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

The car remained ______ at the red light.
solution:
The correct answer is '**stationary**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**stationary**" means not moving or still. (स्थिर)
 
• The car was stationary at the red light, meaning it was not moving.
 
• The other options: "**stationerie**," "**stationery**," and "**stationry**" are either misspelled or unrelated to the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The car remained stationary__ at the red light.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stationery (लेखन सामग्री)**: refers to writing materials like paper, pens, etc.
 
• **Stationerie/Stationry**: These are incorrect spellings and have no meaning.
